titulo: One Trash Night in Seven Takes
caption:
One Trash Night in Seven Takes

Cella is a small black rectangle with a crown, and one trash night in a shared flat is filmed seven times, each take changing one thing. YouTube long video, 16:9. No Short and no Reel in this package.
descripcion:
NAOS. Choose friction.

One trash night in a shared flat, filmed seven times. The bag is full and standing by the door, and each take changes one thing: nobody says it, someone should, I'll take it out, a name on the bag, a deal, a note, and a new bag in the can. Each take ends with two lines, who has the bag and what it cost. Where there is a study it goes on the record; the rest is Cella's opinion, and nobody in the flat gets blamed. For whoever says I'll take it out before anyone asks.

0:00 One trash night
0:45 Take 1 · Nobody says it
1:35 Take 2 · Someone should
2:33 Take 3 · I'll take it out
3:11 Take 4 · A name on the bag
3:52 Take 5 · A deal
4:49 Take 6 · A note
5:24 Take 7 · The new bag
6:04 The night, checked

What the research says (so you can check us):
Latané B, Williams K, Harkins S. (1979). Many hands make light the work: The causes and consequences of social loafing. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 37(6), 822-832. https://doi.org/10.1037/0022-3514.37.6.822
Williams KD, Harkins SG, Latané B. (1981). Identifiability as a deterrant to social loafing: Two cheering experiments. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 40(2), 303-311. https://doi.org/10.1037/0022-3514.40.2.303 (title only: the abstract is not openly available, and the video says so)
Karau SJ, Williams KD. (1993). Social loafing: A meta-analytic review and theoretical integration. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 65(4), 681-706. https://doi.org/10.1037/0022-3514.65.4.681

The voice describes each study narrowly: people asked to clap and shout put in less effort each in a group than alone, in a lab, and a trash bag is only a cousin of that; for the 1981 follow-up all we could check is its title, which says identifiability can deter social loafing; and a review of seventy-eight studies found social loafing to be robust across tasks and populations, with whether effort can be evaluated and what people expect of their co-workers among the strongest influences. The readings of a name on a bag and a deal with a day on it are Cella's, not findings.

#selfawareness #sharedflat #NAOS
alt: A 8-minute video in 16:9 about one trash night in a shared flat, filmed seven times. Cella, a small blocky black figure with two round white eyes and a crown, stands next to a door and a full black trash bag while on-screen cards give the take: 1 nobody says it, with three phone screens glowing on the wall; 2 someone should; 3 I'll take it out, where the door opens on a cold stairwell and the bag goes down; 4 a name on the bag; 5 a deal, today you and Thursday me; 6 a note on the door about where the new bags are; 7 a new bag in the can. Each take ends with a card with two rows, the bag and what it cost. Three studies appear with a stamp: Latané, Williams and Harkins 1979 on the record, Williams, Harkins and Latané 1981 title only, and Karau and Williams 1993 on the record; the rest carries a CELLA'S OPINION stamp or is plain opinion. A one-minute clock runs while the viewer is asked to write down the bag in their place. It ends on For whoever says I'll take it out before anyone asks, then Saying it out loud meant carrying the bag down the stairs in the cold, then Choose friction. The thumbnail shows Cella large with a crown on an amber field, the words One trash night, and a big 7 on a card.

capitulos.titulo: Take 4 · A name on the bag

evolucion: Cierre con persona, sin pedido (regla 8 de la casa): la tarjeta final nombra a quien dice I'll take it out antes de que se lo pidan y no pide guardar, comentar, compartir, enviar ni seguir; no lleva comentario fijado. La línea antes del lema nombra qué costó (acta ene S3, 2d): Saying it out loud meant carrying the bag down the stairs in the cold; se anota como lema explicado para leerlo aparte si N confirma el punto 4 de para-N. El largo queda fuera de los brazos de las pruebas 3a y 3b del acta de la semana (son de Shorts y Reels). Se lee a 48 h y a 7 días como los otros largos: retención, vistas comprometidas y suscriptores por pieza; con los números de hoy valen de orden de magnitud. Un solo largo, como mandó el VP; la misma forma que el de S2 con otro lugar (decisión 1 del VP).
